role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
promise: Raise defence spending to 2.5% of GDP by April 2027, with an ambition of 3% in the next parliament
description: In February 2025 Starmer committed the UK to raising Nato-qualifying defence spending to 2.5% of GDP by April 2027 and set out an ambition to reach 3% in the next parliament. As of 2026 the UK was still below 2.5%, and the government was considering whether to bring forward the increase.
evidence: Commitment restated in the 2025 Defence Investment Plan
2026 reports said the government was weighing an accelerated increase
